label: AWS Athena
description: Long-format metric table queried through the AWS CLI. Athena needs a database and an S3 location for query results; credentials come from the AWS profile or environment.

config.sql: SELECT metric_key, metric_date, value, source, computed_at FROM YOUR_ATHENA_DATABASE.metric_daily WHERE metric_date BETWEEN DATE '{{start}}' AND DATE '{{end}}' ORDER BY metric_key, metric_date
